sources.title: Bert Hinkler
sources.excerpt: Herbert John Louis Hinkler was a pioneer Australian aviator and inventor. He designed and built early aircraft before being the first person to fly solo from England to Australia, completed on 22 February 1928, and the first person to fly solo across the Southern Atlantic Ocean. He married in 1932 at the age of 39, and died less than a year later after crashing into remote countryside near Arezzo, Tuscany, Italy, during a solo flight record attempt. He is considered to be one of the great aviators in history.
